headline: 300 tourists evacuated as fire breaks out at Cox’s Bazar hotel
summary: The blaze started in the ground-floor parking of The Sea Princess Hotel on Friday afternoon; no casualties were reported.
details: A fire broke out at The Sea Princess Hotel in Sugondha Point, Cox’s Bazar, on Friday afternoon, leading to the evacuation of over 300 tourists.
The blaze originated in the ground-floor parking area, where it is initially believed that a short circuit in a generator caused the fire.
Hotel authorities managed to bring the fire under control before the arrival of a unit from the Cox’s Bazar Fire Service and Civil Defence.
The hotel's Managing Director, Abdul Kader, confirmed that all 300 guests were safe and credited the quick action of the staff and the hotel's firefighting facilities.
While no one was injured, the fire caused damage to the generator and parts of the parking area.
This incident occurs within a week of another hotel fire in Cox’s Bazar that claimed 10 lives.
caption:
300 tourists rushed out of a Cox's Bazar hotel on Friday after a fire broke out in the parking area.

A fire broke out at The Sea Princess Hotel in Sugondha Point, Cox’s Bazar, on Friday afternoon, leading to the evacuation of over 300 tourists.

The blaze originated in the ground-floor parking area, where it is initially believed that a short circuit in a generator caused the fire.

Hotel authorities managed to bring the fire under control before the arrival of a unit from the Cox’s Bazar Fire Service and Civil Defence.

The hotel's Managing Director, Abdul Kader, confirmed that all 300 guests were safe and credited the quick action of the staff and the hotel's firefighting facilities.

While no one was injured, the fire caused damage to the generator and parts of the parking area.

This incident occurs within a week of another hotel fire in Cox’s Bazar that claimed 10 lives.

headline: 2 killed as bus rams autorickshaw in Chattogram, bus torched by mob
summary: Two autorickshaw passengers died after a bus veered out of control on the Chattogram-Cox’s Bazar Highway on Friday night.
details: Two autorickshaw passengers were killed after a bus rammed into their vehicle on the Chattogram-Cox’s Bazar Highway in Satkania’s Nayakhal around 8pm on Friday.
Locals reported that a bus traveling from Keranihat to Chattogram City lost control and hit both a parked motorcycle and an autorickshaw.
Following the crash, angry protesters blocked the road and set the bus on fire, bringing traffic to a standstill for approximately 90 minutes.
Nurul Absar, chief of Dohazari Highway Police Station, stated that traffic resumed normal movement around 9:30pm after police cleared the protesters from the scene.
caption:
A fatal road crash in Chattogram left two dead and sparked a mob attack on the bus.

Two autorickshaw passengers were killed after a bus rammed into their vehicle on the Chattogram-Cox’s Bazar Highway in Satkania’s Nayakhal around 8pm on Friday.

Locals reported that a bus traveling from Keranihat to Chattogram City lost control and hit both a parked motorcycle and an autorickshaw.

Following the crash, angry protesters blocked the road and set the bus on fire, bringing traffic to a standstill for approximately 90 minutes.

Nurul Absar, chief of Dohazari Highway Police Station, stated that traffic resumed normal movement around 9:30pm after police cleared the protesters from the scene.
